sources.snippet: Why pick it for Norman AI? Apache license, tiny VRAM needs, and full transparency make OLMo 2 1B a perfect sandbox: spin up edge demos, run interpretability experiments, or ship a "budget" inference tier without changing our Llama-friendly toolchain.
